pick.name: pgvector (Postgres)
pick.why: Vectors sit next to relational rows and tenant/RLS rules - one DB, one backup, one BAA scope; managed Postgres hosts offer it
pick.free_limits: Indexed dims: vector 2,000, halfvec 4,000; storage up to 16,000

alts.name: LanceDB (embedded)
alts.what: Embedded vector DB, Python/TS/Rust SDKs, local files
alts.why: Best for desktop/offline/local-first and no-server RAG

alts.name: Qdrant
alts.what: Dedicated vector DB with filtering, hybrid, cloud free cluster
alts.why: Move here when vector workload outgrows Postgres
alts.free_limits: Free cluster 0.5 vCPU / 1GB RAM / 4GB disk, no HA; HIPAA badge on site (tier coverage unverified)

candidates.name: pgvector
candidates.verdict: Pick: colocated with app data, PHI in one place

candidates.name: sqlite-vec 0.1.9 (2026-03-31)
candidates.verdict: Pre-v1, Mozilla-sponsored; mobile/RN support not documented

candidates.name: Chroma 1.5.9 (2026-05-05)
candidates.verdict: Fine for prototypes; no edge over pgvector

candidates.name: PGlite 0.5.12
candidates.verdict: Postgres in WASM/Node for local-first; young

decision: pgvector because the app needs Postgres anyway and colocating embeddings with tenant data simplifies access control and compliance. Move to Qdrant at millions of vectors or heavy filtering; use LanceDB for offline desktop RAG.
